title: Evaluating & Choosing LLMs — Measure Variability and Failure Tails
key_insight: Repeat stochastic cases, report distributions, and track severe-failure rates. Test long inputs, missing context, adversarial wording, and provider errors.
body:
## Measure Variability and Failure Tails

One run looks excellent, but repeated generations sometimes violate the format. Average quality hides the bad tail.

Repeat stochastic cases, report distributions, and track severe-failure rates. Test long inputs, missing context, adversarial wording, and provider errors.

Version prompts, model identifiers, settings, tools, and evaluation data. Re-run the suite before accepting a provider or model update.
common_mistakes: The biggest model is automatically best for every product.
One public benchmark replaces task-specific testing.
A model-based grader is perfectly objective and never changes.
mini_exercise: Draw “Measure Variability and Failure Tails” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: Model families and versions change quickly, so a repeatable evaluation process is more durable than one recommendation.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Measure Variability and Failure Tails,” explain Evaluating & Choosing LLMs without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
